title: Artist Drops Diss Track On Mavs' Luka Doncic Called 'Who You Going To Blame Now' [Listen]
htmlContent:
Luka Doncic, the Slovenian basketball sensation, was considered one of the top contenders for the NBA's Most Valuable Player award entering the 2022-23 season. After an impressive start to his professional career, Doncic continued to dominate the league with his exceptional playmaking ability, shooting accuracy, and clutch performances.

His incredible skillset, leadership qualities, and unmatched work ethic made him a formidable force on the court, as he consistently led his team to victories. With his impressive track record and undeniable talent, it was no surprise that Doncic was a frontrunner for the coveted MVP award, and fans and analysts alike eagerly anticipated another incredible season from the young superstar.

Unfortunately, for the Dallas Mavericks and Luka Doncic throughout the season, things have not gone the way the Mavericks have wanted to go, as they are currently 36-39 and in the 11th spot in the Western Conference. The Mavericks are coming off back-to-back losses to the Charlotte Hornets with a 117-109 loss on Sunday afternoon. Luka Doncic finished with 40 points, 12 rebounds, and eight assists. He also received his 16th tech of the season, and if it's not rescinded, he will be suspended for Monday's game against the Indiana Pacers.

After the game, a Twitter user named ßerris [@boxmethen] dropped a diss track aimed at four-time All-Luka Doncic called, 'Who You Going To Blame Now.'

The track can be heard in its full entirety below!
